title: Job hunt
audience: For anyone applying to more than a handful of jobs at once.
description: Every application on a board by stage, what's due today, and your interview prep. Paste a job ad into your AI and it adds the card.
tagline: Every application, by stage, and what's due.
seoTitle: Job hunt tracker template and app for ChatGPT and Claude
note:
Job hunt

Your applications live in the app: a board by stage, what's due today and your interview prep. Paste a job ad into your AI and it adds the card; tell it when you hear back and it moves it.

## What I'm looking for
The roles, places and pay you want. Your AI checks each ad against this.

## How it's going
Ask your AI how the search is going, and its lines land here.

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Job hunt". It is an app, with its data in "Job hunt.app/data.json". Read it with fetch before each change; change it with edit. When I paste a job ad or link, add { id, company, role, link, salary, contact, stage: "saved", steps: [] } to values.jobs, leaving out what the ad doesn't say; an apply-by date goes in steps as { id, kind: "deadline", date }. When I apply or hear back, set stage to an id from values.stages and applied or heard (yyyy-mm-dd); add an interview as { id, kind: "interview", date, time: "hh:mm" }. A no is stage "closed", outcome "rejected". To prep me, add questions as { q, a } with my talking points, and ask: what to ask them.

asks: Ask me for the job ad I want to save, then add it to my board.
I heard back from Tideway: first interview Thursday at 14:00. Help me prep.
